clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, warlocks seek Comar's Heart to draw a succubus into their service. The heart belonged to Comar Villard, a human searching the Wetlands for his lost wife.

Comar Villard keeps searching the Wetlands for his lost wife. Though turmoil has swept the Eastern Kingdoms, he refuses to abandon the search. Carendin Halgar's disciples in the Undercity judge his fidelity among the rarest and purest. To bind a succubus, a creature both capricious and predatory, warlocks need devotion like his as bait. Comar's steadfast love marks him for slaughter, and his heart becomes the lure for a demonic servant.
